_note: Unmodified HTML (as decoded by httpx, written as UTF-8) of ISRO's official careers listing pages (www.isro.gov.in), fetched over https with PageFetcher.fetch_http under the url_guard policy for www.isro.gov.in. robots.txt returned HTTP 404 at capture time (no restrictions). No browser was needed: the notice board and the opportunities table are in the served HTML (list.min.js only paginates them client-side).
